description.short_caption: Grouped vesicular lesions on an erythematous base on the lateral torso.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a cluster of vesicular lesions on an erythematous base distributed along a dermatomal pattern on the lateral torso. The lesions appear to be at various stages, with some vesicles intact and others crusted. The distribution suggests a unilateral involvement, consistent with a dermatomal pattern. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema without significant swelling.
